mix.heard_lane_note: Ingest used to overwrite shot_data after STT, wiping heard_audio. This slice therefore muxed ElevenLabs TTS to each take's picture_start (no J-cut). bindShotTake now preserves heard_audio so native Wan audio can be kept on the next render when STT matches.

frame_by_frame.see: Insert: TUESDAY slip on stone. Mute-readable spike. No caption. Not a face ECU.
Kitchen night two-person wide: marble island, chandelier, city windows, second pair of hands on the island. Geography locked.
Caption 'Eli Hart, look at Tuesday.' full, unclipped, lower-third. Kitchen night with under-cabinet key + city window.
Mara MCU, same kitchen night plate (subway tile, faucet, city). No random forest bokeh.
Comic/stun line 'I did not write the paper.' fully visible, lower-third (~75–79%). Mouth open on the line. Kitchen island + city still in frame.
Eli single, same kitchen night grade (marble, faucet, city).
OTS + caption 'Then say who wrote the paper.' wrapped, unclipped, lower-third.
Two-line caption measured y=74.2–79.2% of 1280: 'Eli Hart, the paper still has a name.' Never clipped.
Wrapped 4–8 words: 'If it is not Eli Hart, who / signed Tuesday?' y=73.7–78.8%. Not TikTok chrome.
Comic/stun cutaway: boxed TUESDAY paper insert (SFX/paper beat).
Location change: banquet/estate OTS, candles, stained glass. Caption 'Eli Hart, look at Tuesday.' unclipped. Establishing/wide exists in this block.

beep.how: Deleted deterministic 110/880 sine/ping bed. assembleEpisodeMp4 loads assets/music or silentWav. Never synthesizes a sine.
beep.evidence: Goertzel on mix: t=0.5s p110=3 vs p200=55 (no bed tone). Product path has no Math.sin / 110Hz / 880Hz. ffmpeg-mix.test asserts that.

lipsync.how: Onscreen speech: audio_start === picture_start (no J-cut lead). Prefer native Wan when STT WER matches; else mux TTS to THAT take's picture clock. Offscreen stays silent lips + TTS. Emotion: eleven_v3 tags [crying]/[shouts]/[whispers] + style. ingest now bindShotTake so heard_audio survives QC.
lipsync.evidence: Timeline unit: audio_start equals picture_start. Slice 17.0s: mouth open on 'I did not write the paper.' Emotional takes generated (cry/break/hot). This cut used TTS-to-picture because ingest wiped heard_audio; that wipe is fixed for createEngine().renderEpisode().

lighting.how: One location plate + 'same key light as location plate' in prompts. Establishing/wide when the block location changes. Face CUs get lighting lock in text, not a second location still (identity).
lighting.evidence: Frames 4.5–40s stay kitchen night (marble, under-cabinet, city windows). 102s is a new banquet/estate interior after the location change, not a dark forest CU.

coverage.how: Lint COVERAGE_MIX: ≥1 establishing/wide, ≥1 silent stacked_two when 2+ named people, inserts, not 100% ECU. Two-shots only silent/wides.
coverage.evidence: Locked 3 establishing + 3 stacked_two + 6 inserts + 12 singles + 6 reaction/listener. Frames: TUESDAY insert, kitchen two-person wide, OTS, banquet OTS.

captions.how: CAPTION_STYLE.bandFromTopPct 70–82, wrapCaptionLines 4–8 words / 32 chars, PIL measure + shrink, keepOutBottomPx 200.
captions.evidence: VTT lines wrap (e.g. 'Eli Hart, the paper still has a / name.'). Pixel measure on 34.5s and 40.8s: 73.7–79.2%. Founder clipped line is gone. drama-hq-caption-check.jpg at 17.0s shows the full comic line.

music.how: ElevenLabs music_v2 + SFX generated once into assets/music. Mix: bed under friction, duck on dialogue, sting on spike, SFX on cutaways.
music.evidence: Library on disk (4 beds, 3 stings, 4 sfx). Mix RMS 0.11 with dialogue peaks; not silence and not sine. romance-under and estate-night are the same byte size (possible API duplicate) — thriller-friction and tension-pad are distinct.

writing.how: Punchy public-humiliation lines, mute-readable TUESDAY paper, comic sting on 'I did not write the paper.', COMIC_STING lint per block cluster.
writing.evidence: VTT cue 2 at 16.5s is the full comic line. Insert frames at 0.4s and 50s. Block-1/2 variants keep the stun cutaway + 'who signed Tuesday?' button.
